name: Todano Armory music
author: nominalsan
description: On Todano, walking into the Megacorp Armory leaves the outside music playing: the entrance's trigger asks for no track. This mod asks for the Armory's track when that trigger fires, crossfading as the game does.

settings.name: Track
settings.description: The music track to play in the Armory. -1: the track of the environment preset nearest Ratchet when he walks in, the one the game itself plays when it puts him there.
